items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: Louie Mitchell was over there. And the old Pabr group of Breaktown was over. I heard a lot of those people back in, in, in, being in Europe.

ctx.x: Tivoli. Well, and so I saved so much money. And I used to buy those different magazines in Mexico just to keep myself reading in English. Oh, yeah. And I read in some magazine about the bands that was in Europe. You see, in the Noble Sister, I think. Yeah. You record it. The Man Cook, the Man Cook, Wilman Cook was over, and Louie Mitchell was over there. And the old Pabr group of Breaktown was over. I heard a lot of those people back in, in, in, being in Europe.
